name: Da Nang
summary: Da Nang has become one of the most popular nomadic hubs in Southeast Asia: urban beach in My Khe, very low cost of living and very fast internet. The city combines modern skyscrapers with nearby mountains and temples, and its coworking and work cafe scene grows every year. The biggest drawback is the season of typhoons and heavy rains between September and December, in addition to the need to actively manage visas as there is no specific nomadic visa.
